Must be an Arizona resident for tuition purposes, must be a transfer student from an Arizona community college, must have a minimum 3.50 cumulative transfer GPA, must demonstrate financial need as determined by the FAFSA, must have submitted an ASU admission application, application fee and transcripts from each school attended by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring, must have submitted a FAFSA for the appropriate academic year by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
Only available to incoming campus or online students; current ASU students are ineligible.

Award can be renewed for a total of four consecutive semesters (excluding summers) by completing 24 ASU credit hours with a 2.50 or higher ASU cumulative GPA and submitting a FAFSA by the above deadlines each year that demonstrates continued financial need.
The grant amount varies each year and is typically awarded in the fall semester; spring amounts are dependent on the remaining funds from the previous fall.

Corporate partners, students on the All-Arizona Academic Team, active duty military and/or veterans, and veteran dependents (Yellow Ribbon) are not eligible for the Transfer Achievement Grant due to the existing benefits they are eligible for.
Requests must be submitted at least two weeks before the start of your admit term, must continue to meet all eligibility and renewal requirements.
Domestic transfer students are provided one extra semester past their admit term to enroll without needing to reapply or defer their admission.
Financial aid packaging typically begins in March for fall admits, and October for spring admits; financial aid packaging can take 4–6 weeks after completing your financial aid file.
